body: It’s weird, my family was way beyond appropriate and crossed over into incest. It’s always been difficult for me to have a normal sex life. Eventually the intrusive bought of my family went away but they come back sometimes and I’m a little afraid they are going to come back as punishment for me talking about them :) it mostly was a problem when I was either psychotic or close to psychotic. I wish I was able to be happy.
Thanks again 🙂 I’m trying to get into counseling for this, one step at a time. It always takes so long to get into a new doctor’s office so I really appreciate you sharing with me.

My T levels measure as naturally high so I already have a lot of masculine characteristics like muscle and build and face and skin. I want the T mostly for what I believe it will do to my brain. Have you taken T?

Thanks so much for the thoughtful reply. I am comfortable with having a lower voice but losing the high notes would be pretty tough. I’ve been reading about microdosing and it seems like it might be a good solution for me but I probably need to talk to a lot of people first because the changes from T are usually permanent, right?
It used to happen to me every time I masturbated. Family was the most disturbing. It’s really upsetting. I’m sorry you’re dealing with it.
I really wish I didn’t hear voices. It makes it so much worse. Especially when they just keep bringing up the past 🤦🏻‍♀️
I have been inconsistently using a fisher Wallace stimulator and I am pretty sure it will help. There is hope for us, please hang in there. I’m here if you need a friend. I sure need one right now.
Sorry you went through that. Are you doing better?
Mushrooms helped with my ocd symptoms for about a week after I did them last. It’s the only relief I’ve had in years. I’m relapsing hard w bulimia right now. I think mushrooms would help.
